name: Krizis: tretij put'
source:
The game takes place in 2034, eight years after World War III. Amid the ruins of the old world, new leaders, the European Economic Cooperation (EEC) and Communist China, are vying for global domination, drawing ever more countries into the conflict. The story of one of these countries is the focus of the novel.

The Ural Republic, a country that emerged from the ruins of Russia, has been drawn into a bloody conflict. Now the country's fate depends not only on the will of its leaders, but also on the will of an ordinary man, namely, Yevgeny Krylov, a junior sergeant in the Special Order Control Service (SSKP) and the game's protagonist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111170/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在2034年，即第三次世界大战八年后。在旧世界的废墟中，新的领导人欧洲经济合作组织（EEC）和共产主义中国正在争夺全球统治地位，将越来越多的国家卷入冲突。其中一个国家的故事是小说的重点。

乌拉尔共和国，一个从俄罗斯废墟中崛起的国家，已经陷入了血腥冲突。现在，国家的命运不仅取决于领导人的意志，还取决于一个普通人的意志，即叶夫根尼·克雷洛夫（Yevgeny Krylov），他是特别命令控制服务（SSKP）的初级中士，也是游戏的主角。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111170/]Steam[/url]]
